proposed_statement_changes.proposed: If \(\mathcal P\) is the complete all-circle COPAG, every observed variable has at least two states, and \(|\Omega_B|\ge2\), then \(\Theta_\delta(\mathcal P,q)=[L_\delta,U_\delta]\), where \(L_\delta\) and \(U_\delta\) are given by the closed-form saturated envelope. Both endpoints are attained by a one-source SCM with at most \(m+1\) positive-mass response types. If \(h\) is constant, the interval is the singleton \(\{h_-\}\); if the intervention is vacuous, the fiber is the singleton \(\{\sum_{v\in\Omega_V}q(v)h(A(v))\}\).
